technology.title: Waterbee Core Technology
technology.subtitle: Proprietary core technology in water quality measurement — Patents, type approvals & field-proven

rotating_electrode.title: Rotating Electrode Residual Chlorine Measurement
rotating_electrode.subtitle: The electrode rotates to suppress fouling, enabling long-duration residual chlorine monitoring in waterworks and industrial field environments.
rotating_electrode.description: Waterbee's patented rotating electrode technology mechanically mitigates surface contamination, greatly improving stability and electrode life versus conventional fixed electrodes. It delivers high accuracy within ±0.02 mg/L across the 0.01~2.00 mg/L residual chlorine range while reducing maintenance burden without membrane consumables.

points.title: Low-maintenance membrane-free structure
points.description: By eliminating the replacement membrane used in conventional methods, the analyzer reduces service cost and downtime in the field.

points.title: Stable measurement under changing flow conditions
points.description: The rotating electrode and ion-coated surface minimize error caused by flow variation and electrode fouling.

points.title: Designed for long-term stability
points.description: Continuous surface conditioning helps suppress signal drift during extended operation.

steps.title: Sample inflow
steps.description: Sample water enters the measurement cell so residual chlorine reaches the reaction area in a consistent way.

steps.title: Electrode rotation
steps.description: The drive motor rotates the electrode at a constant speed to reduce deposits and keep reaction conditions uniform.

steps.title: Current detection
steps.description: The analyzer detects current proportional to residual chlorine concentration and converts it into a precise reading.

steps.title: Controller output
steps.description: The WBSC10 controller displays the result and forwards it to higher-level systems through RS-485, Modbus, and 4~20mA.

rotating_items: Continuous rotation reduces fouling buildup on the electrode surface
Lower maintenance cost thanks to reduced consumable burden
More stable output with reduced drift during long continuous operation
fixed_items: Surface contamination can accumulate and shorten manual cleaning intervals
Frequent consumable replacement and calibration can increase operating burden
Signal variation may become larger as field flow and contamination conditions change

scattering.title: 90° Scattered Light Turbidity Measurement
scattering.description: Following ISO 7027 standards, the 90° scattered light method enables linear and precise measurement from low to high turbidity. Automatic correction of light source drift ensures long-term accuracy.

communication.title: Industrial Communication Protocols
communication.description: Standard support for RS-485, Modbus RTU/TCP, and 4~20mA analog output enables easy integration with existing SCADA, PLC, and DCS systems.
